
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/nijunyang/p/19158774" title="发布于 2025-10-25 09:11">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">k8s集群部署(1)(centos7)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>直接进入主题，采用kubeadm方式构建集群，一个master，2个node，1个镜像仓库，准备4台机器，我用的虚拟机装的centos7，2C2G。网络配置好，保证虚拟机能访问外网，虚拟机和宿主能互相访问。</p>
<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" title="发布于 2019-12-07 12:27" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/nijunyang/p/12001312.html"><span>VMware安装虚拟机及网络配置</span></a></h1>
<h1>一、机器前置处理</h1>
<p>配置一下几台机器的相关信息</p>
<p>我机器ip是192.168.255.101/104，计划是101作为master，102，103 作为node，104作为私有镜像仓库</p>
<h3>1. 主机名设置 方便互相访问：</h3>
<div class="lake-content"><span class="ne-text">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">vim /etc/hosts</code><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;&nbsp;</span> 添加以下内容：所有机器</span></div>
<div class="lake-content">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255.101</span> k8s-master.taoyao.com k8s-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">master
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255.102</span> k8s-node1.taoyao.com k8s-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">node1
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255.103</span> k8s-node2.taoyao.com k8s-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">node2
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255.104</span> k8s-harbor.taoyao.com k8s-harbor</pre>
</div>
<h3>2. 配置互相ssh免密</h3>
<p>在101上操作&nbsp;&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">ssh-keygen -t rsa</code><span class="ne-text">&nbsp; 生成密钥对</span></p>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">执行脚本复制到其他机器：<br></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">102</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">103</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">104</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
ssh</span>-copy-id root@<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.$i
done</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>3. 设置对应机器的主机名和上面hosts文件中内容对应</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>hostnamectl <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>-hostname k8s-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">master
hostnamectl </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>-hostname k8s-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">node1
hostnamectl </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>-hostname k8s-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">node2
hostnamectl </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>-hostname k8s-harbor</pre>
</div>
<h3>4. 机器参数调整（所有机器）</h3>
<p>这里推荐使用mobaxterm，相比xshell这些，他可以批量操作，同时在多台机器执行输入相同的命令</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022170319764-1736217042.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022170444279-191286065.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h4>4.1&nbsp;<span class="ne-text">禁用交换分区</span></h4>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u4cd8ddad" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">vim /etc/selinux/config</span></code><span class="ne-text">&nbsp; </span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">将 SELINUX=enforcing 改为 SELINUX=disabled</span></p>
<p id="u3871067e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text"> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">reboot</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 重启</span></span></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022170627691-917914677.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u9435af4f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">临时禁用： <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">swapoff -a</span></code></span></p>
<p id="u10402d58" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">永久禁用：<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">sed -i 's/.*swap.*/#&amp;/' /etc/fstab</span></code></span></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text"><span class="ne-text">4.2 k8s相关的内核参数调整：</span></span></h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>cat &gt;&gt; /etc/sysctl.d/k8s.conf &lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EOF
vm.swappiness</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
EOF</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h4>&nbsp;4.3 网络参数调整</h4>
<p>依次执行</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="uc980014c" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">modprobe br_netfilter</span></code></p>
<p id="ud3ce9848" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">modprobe overlay</span></code></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>cat &gt;&gt; /etc/sysctl.d/k8s.conf &lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EOF
net.bridge.bridge</span>-nf-call-ip6tables = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
net.bridge.bridge</span>-nf-call-iptables = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
net.ipv4.ip_forward </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
EOF</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="lake-content">&nbsp;&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/k8s.conf</code><span class="ne-text">&nbsp; &nbsp;</span></div>
</div>
<h1 class="ne-p">二、安装容器引擎----docker相关</h1>
<h3 class="ne-p">1.docker安装（所有机器）</h3>
<p class="ne-p">CentOS 7 已于 2024 年 6 月 30 日停止维护（EOL - End of Life），官方镜像站 <code>mirrorlist.centos.org</code> 已经下线，导致 <code>yum</code> 无法获取软件包列表，所以这里我们换成阿里的yum</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 备份原配置
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cp</span> -r /etc/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span>.repos.d /etc/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.repos.d.backup

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 下载阿里云镜像配置
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">wget</span> -O /etc/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span>.repos.d/CentOS-Base.repo http:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">mirrors.aliyun.com/repo/Centos-7.repo</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 清理缓存并测试
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> clean all
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span> makecache</pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="uf78119d2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">使用阿里云yum镜像：<a class="ne-link" href="https://developer.aliyun.com/mirror/docker-ce?spm=a2c6h.13651102.0.0.655e1b11Kk456X" target="_blank" data-href="https://developer.aliyun.com/mirror/docker-ce?spm=a2c6h.13651102.0.0.655e1b11Kk456X" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="ne-text">https://developer.aliyun.com/mirror/docker-ce</span></a></span></p>
<p id="u918c4236" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">按上面地址的指引操作即可，默认下载的时最新的，或者选择指定的版本安装：</span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我选择安装的24.0.4-1.el7</span></p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># step <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 安装必要的一些系统工具
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> -y <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">utils

# Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 添加软件源信息
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span>-config-manager --add-repo https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">mirrors.aliyun.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#查看docker 版本
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span> list docker-ce --showduplicates | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sort</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">r

# Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>: 安装Docker  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.el7</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> -y docker-ce-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.el7

#设置开启自启动
systemctl enable docker 

# 开启Docker服务
service docker start</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>2. docker相关配置修改</h3>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u512ebd68" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">（1）cgroup改为systemd （参考：https://kubernetes.io/zh-cn/docs/setup/production-environment/container-runtimes/）</span></p>
<p id="uba83c7b0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">（2）镜像仓库修改（国内的更快）</span></p>
<p id="ub6a5a358" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">（3）使用私有镜像仓库（104这台机器）</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022184425273-130928571.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u46328bbd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">除了仓库节点其他都执行以下脚本（101，102，103）机器执行：</span></p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cat</span> &gt;&gt; /etc/docker/daemon.json &lt;&lt;-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EOF 
{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">registry-mirrors</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:[
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://docker.211678.top</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://docker.1panel.live</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://hub.rat.dev</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://docker.m.daocloud.io</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://do.nark.eu.org</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://dockerpull.com</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://dockerproxy.cn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://docker.awsl9527.cn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  ],
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">insecure-registries</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">k8s-harbor.taoyao.com</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],#和上面主机名的仓库机器对应
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">exec-opts</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">native.cgroupdriver=systemd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]

}
EOF</span></pre>
</div>
<p># 重新加载 systemd 配置</p>
<p><code class="ne-code">systemctl daemon-reload</code><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p># 重启 Docker</p>
<p>&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">systemctl restart docker</code><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;</span></p>






</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u7248e4d6" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">docker info</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 查看配置是否修改成功</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022190059250-2057421060.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>






</div>
<h3>3.&nbsp;cri环境 搭建</h3>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u7083c7f6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">CRI（Container Runtime Interface）是Kubernetes定义的与容器运行时交互的标准接口，而Docker是一种流行的容器管理工具。两者在容器生态中的关系如下：</span></p>
<p id="u0b49a068" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">CRI与Docker的协作机制</span></p>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u4a9e9411" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">‌<strong><span class="ne-text">CRI的作用</span></strong><span class="ne-text">‌：CRI允许Kubernetes通过标准化接口与不同的容器运行时（如containerd、CRI-O）交互，实现容器的生命周期管理<span class="ne-text">12<span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></span></li>
<li id="u1d388f09" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">‌<strong><span class="ne-text">Docker的适配</span></strong><span class="ne-text">‌：Docker本身不直接实现CRI，但可通过<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">cri-dockerd</span></code><span class="ne-text">（原Dockershim的替代方案）作为适配层，将Docker的API转换为CRI兼容的接口，从而支持Kubernetes调度<span class="ne-text"><span class="ne-text"><span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></li>





</ol>
<p id="ue8511d15" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">技术演进与现状</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u2193beca" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">‌<strong><span class="ne-text">历史依赖</span></strong><span class="ne-text">‌：早期Kubernetes依赖Docker作为默认运行时，但Docker的封闭生态与Kubernetes的开源理念冲突，促使Kubernetes推出CRI标准以解耦依赖</span></span></li>





</ul>
<p id="u687c3601" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u62b634c8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">下载cri-dockerd （除仓库机器，都需要）</span></p>
<p id="u23b43282" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">mkdir /data/softs</code><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<p id="u9d7def85" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">cd /data/softs</code><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;</span>&nbsp; 我是下载到这个目录</span></p>
<p id="u771437a8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">wget https://github.com/Mirantis/cri-dockerd/releases/download/v0.3.2/cri-dockerd-0.3.2.amd64.tgz</code></span></p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="uf9f8853c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">可能需要梯子，如果无法直接下载就单独下载了上传到上去，先传了一台然后复制到其他去，或者分别上传</span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">之前就做了免密直接复制到另外两台去</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">102</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">103</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">scp</span> cri-dockerd-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.3</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>.amd64.tgz root@<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span>.$i:/data/softs/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">done</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u4e2eed2d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">解压软件 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">tar xf cri-dockerd-0.3.2.amd64.tgz</span></code></span></p>
<p id="uff5ba9ed" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">mv cri-dockerd/cri-dockerd /usr/local/bin/</span></code></p>
<p id="u11b98f02" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">检查效果 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">cri-dockerd --version</span></code></span></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u624b7865" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">将 cri-dockerd 通过配置文件制作成服务方面开机启动：</span></p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cat</span> &gt; /etc/systemd/system/cri-dockerd.service&lt;&lt;-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EOF
[Unit]
Description</span>=CRI Interface <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Docker Application Container Engine
Documentation</span>=https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">docs.mirantis.com</span>
After=network-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">online.target firewalld.service docker.service
Wants</span>=network-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">online.target
[Service]
Type</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">notify
ExecStart</span>=/usr/local/bin/cri-dockerd --pod-infra-container-image=registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/google_containers/pause:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3.9</span> --network-plugin=cni --cni-conf-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dir</span>=/etc/cni/net.d --cni-bin-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dir</span>=/opt/cni/bin --container-runtime-endpoint=unix:<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">var/run/cri-dockerd.sock --cri-dockerd-root-directory=/var/lib/dockershim --docker-endpoint=unix:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">var/run/docker.sock --cri-dockerd-root-directory=/var/lib/docker</span>
ExecReload=/bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">kill</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">s HUP $MAINPID
TimeoutSec</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
RestartSec</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Restart</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">always
StartLimitBurst</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
StartLimitInterval</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">60s
LimitNOFILE</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">infinity
LimitNPROC</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">infinity
LimitCORE</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">infinity
TasksMax</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">infinity
Delegate</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">yes
KillMode</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">process
[Install]
WantedBy</span>=multi-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">user.target
EOF</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cat</span> &gt;/etc/systemd/system/cri-dockerd.socket &lt;&lt;-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EOF
[Unit]
Description</span>=CRI Docker Socket <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> the API
Partof</span>=cri-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">docker.service
[socket]
Listenstream</span>=/var/run/cri-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dockerd.sock
SocketMode</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0660</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Socketuser</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">root
SocketGroup</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">docker
[Install]
wantedBy</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sockets.target
EOF</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="uc86da197" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">设置服务并机自启动</span></p>
<p id="u14c67105" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">systemctl daemon-reload</span></code></p>
<p id="u1ba4a7ce" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">systemctl enable cri-dockerd.service</span></code></p>
<p id="u0d552032" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">systemctl restart cri-dockerd.service</span></code></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u5fb10e84" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">状态查看：<span class="ne-text">&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">systemctl status cri-dockerd&nbsp;</code><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;</span></span></span></p>
<p id="u544e971d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">systemctl is-active cri-dockerd</code><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">4.&nbsp;harbor仓库配置（104 仓库机器操作）</span></h3>
</div>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u5bae5b06" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">下载harbor: <a class="ne-link" href="https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/releases" target="_blank" data-href="https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/releases" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="ne-text">https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/releases</span></a></span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="uab99c67c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">虚拟机网络不行可以使用宿主机下载相应的版本后上传到虚拟机再操作，可能需要用梯子</span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text"><code class="ne-code">tar xf harbor-offline-installer-v2.14.0.tgz&nbsp;</code></span></p>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u54b843ab" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">解压进入harbor目录 加载harbor中的本地镜像</span></p>
<p id="uf735fd53" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">docker load &lt; harbor.v2.14.0.tar.gz</span></code></p>
<p id="uef8f0c9f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">修改harbor中的配置文件模板：</span></p>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022195136340-1825706586.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;基于模版复制一份正式出来修改：&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">cp harbor.yml.tmpl&nbsp; harbor.yml&nbsp;</code></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">vim&nbsp;harbor.yml&nbsp;</code></p>
<p>hostname修改前面设置harbor机器的域名</p>
<p>https的配置去掉</p>
<p>admin密码修改</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022195535473-737341890.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u3337b5be" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">执行 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">./prepare</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 脚本 生成相应docker-compose.yml内容</span></span></p>
<p id="ub044963d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">执行 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">./install</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 启动harbor脚本，会使用prepare之后生成的docker-compose.yml文件启动</span></span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022195858606-1467061653.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u63512e3c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">docker compose ps&nbsp;</code> 命令用于列出当前目录下由 docker-compose.yml 文件定义的所有容器的运行状态</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022202145782-2006187577.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="ne-p">将harbor配置成服务，并设置开机自启动：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cat</span> &gt; /etc/systemd/system/harbor.service&lt;&lt;-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EOF
[Unit]
Description</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Harbor
After</span>=docker.service systemd-networkd.service systemd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">resolved.service
Requires</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">docker.service
Documentation</span>=http:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">github.com/viware/harbor</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Service]
Type</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">simple
Restart</span>=on-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">failure
RestartSec</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
ExecStart</span>=/usr/bin/docker compose --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">file</span> /data/softs/harbor/docker-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">compose.yml up
ExecStop</span>=/usr/bin/docker compose --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">file</span> /data/softs/harbor/docker-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">compose.yml down
[Install]
WantedBy</span>=multi-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">user.target
EOF</span></pre>
</div>
<pre><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker compose --file /data/softs/harbor/docker-compose.yml up
ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker compose --file /data/softs/harbor/docker-compose.yml down</span><br><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">这两个要注意和自己的安装目录对应上</span></pre>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u6e0c577f" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">systemctl daemon-reload&nbsp; 重新加载</span></code></p>
<p id="ue507e932" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">systemctl start harbor&nbsp; 重启</span></code></p>
<p id="u89ddfc92" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">systemctl status harbor&nbsp; 状态查看</span></code></p>
<p id="u019b5654" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">systemctl enable harbor&nbsp; 开机自启动</span></code></p>
</div>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p>访问104机器的IP 使用admin登录harbor，然后创建一个个人账户，再登录个人账户，创建一个公共项目用于存放我们自己镜像</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022202525827-1324525240.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="ub54f0658" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">向harbor仓库提交镜像：</span></p>
<p id="u17e43b08" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">1.镜像打标签</span></p>
<p id="u81ad6ada" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">必须携带harbor主机地址：</span></p>
<p id="ucca5c902" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">docker tag 镜像 新镜像标签名（主机名/项目/镜像名：版本）</span></p>
<p id="ue464fe6d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">2.登录harbor</span></p>
<p id="u1b59d597" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">docker login harbor仓库</span></p>
<p id="u600e16e1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">3.提交镜像</span></p>
<p id="u7f70e4e0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">docker push 具体镜像标签</span></p>
<p id="u19dadb34" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">切换到101（192.168.255.101）机器上面尝试操作 打一个镜像并推送到104（192.168.255.104）机器harbor仓库：</span></p>
<p id="udf418024" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我们拉取一个nginx：<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">docker pull nginx:1.29.1 (拉取速度会很慢)</span></code></span></p>
<p id="ud9af109d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">将拉取的nginx镜像打成自己的镜像：&nbsp;</span></p>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;docker tag 镜像 新镜像标签名（主机名/项目/镜像名：版本）</p>
<p>&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">docker tag nginx:1.29.1 k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/my-nginx:1.29.1</code></p>
<div class="lake-content">&nbsp;</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022202956548-940557243.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content"><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">docker login k8s-harbor.taoyao.com&nbsp;&nbsp;</code>登录harbor仓库 输入前面创建的个人账号信息</span></div>
<div class="lake-content">&nbsp;</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022203120169-445535620.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u0f359d60" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">推送镜像： <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">docker push k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/my-nginx:1.29.1</span></code></span></p>
</div>
<p>推送成功之后仓库里面就已经可以看到这个镜像了</p>
<p>可以去102（192.168.255.102）机器拉取这个镜像：</p>
<div class="lake-content"><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;&nbsp;<code class="ne-code">docker&nbsp;pull k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/my-nginx:1.29.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</code></span></div>
<div class="lake-content"><span class="ne-text">速度直接飞一般的感觉了</span></div>
<div class="lake-content">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="lake-content">&nbsp;</div>
<h1 class="lake-content"><span class="ne-text">三、k8s集群搭建（101,102,103 机器操作）</span></h1>
<div class="lake-content">
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="ud0f9d920" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">使用kubeadm 方式搭建集群</span></p>
<p id="u519ea6be" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">步骤：软件源定制——&gt;安装软件——&gt;镜像获取——&gt;主节点初始化——&gt;工作节点加入集群</span></p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="uc187c5cc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">1.软件源定制：k8s 节点执行 master node 都需要</span></p>
<p id="u84b514aa" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">使用阿里云的: <a class="ne-link" href="https://developer.aliyun.com/mirror/" target="_blank" data-href="https://developer.aliyun.com/mirror/" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="ne-text">https://developer.aliyun.com/mirror/</span></a><span class="ne-text"> 找到k8s 按里面的脚本操作：</span></span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022204059768-1782235473.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cat</span> &lt;&lt;EOF | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">tee</span> /etc/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span>.repos.d/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kubernetes.repo
[kubernetes]
name</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Kubernetes
baseurl</span>=https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">mirrors.aliyun.com/kubernetes-new/core/stable/v1.28/rpm/</span>
enabled=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
gpgcheck</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
gpgkey</span>=https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">mirrors.aliyun.com/kubernetes-new/core/stable/v1.28/rpm/repodata/repomd.xml.key</span>
exclude=kubelet kubeadm kubectl cri-tools kubernetes-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cni
EOF</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u2441bf01" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">yum makecache fast</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 刷新yum源</span></p>
<p id="uac1690c4" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">安装软件：</span></p>
<p class="ne-p">yum install -y kubelet kubeadm kubectl <span class="hljs-attribute">--disableexcludes=kubernetes&nbsp; &nbsp;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">我用的生产的那种 禁用了更新的（</span></span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">exclude=kubelet kubeadm kubectl cri-tools kubernetes-cni</span><span class="hljs-attribute"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">）</span> 所以使用这条命令，注意上面有两个使用对应的即可</span></p>
<p id="u9494a043" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">systemctl enable kubelet &amp;&amp; systemctl start kubelet</span></code></p>
<p id="u5d67a16f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kubeadm：集群管理使用</span></p>
<p id="u77f7bee7" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kubelet：采集节点数据汇报给master</span></p>
<p id="ub405c6fb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kubectl：管理集群资源对象</span></p>
<p id="ud8bcc894" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubeadm version</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 查看k8s 版本</span></p>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content"><span class="ne-text"><span class="ne-text"><code class="ne-code">kubeadm config images list&nbsp;</code></span></span><span class="ne-text">查看所需的镜像版本</span></div>
<div class="lake-content">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251022205502751-770393973.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u0e306d56" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.k8s.io/kube-apiserver:v1.28.15</span></p>
<p id="u0c8e23df" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.k8s.io/kube-controller-manager:v1.28.15</span></p>
<p id="ubaba7d3c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.k8s.io/kube-scheduler:v1.28.15</span></p>
<p id="u7ee5da87" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.k8s.io/kube-proxy:v1.28.15</span></p>
<p id="ua4ffca9a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.k8s.io/pause:3.9</span></p>
<p id="u40e79997" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.k8s.io/etcd:3.5.15-0</span></p>
<p id="u76648a0a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.k8s.io/coredns/coredns:v1.10.1</span></p>
<p id="u894e34bc" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u92bf8fb5" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">registry.k8s.io</span></code><span class="ne-text"> google的地址国内可能无法访问</span></p>
<p id="udf06a3f1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">可以使用阿里云的：路径如下：</span></p>
<p id="ucb7c04ec" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.aliyuncs.com/google_containers<span class="ne-text">/kube-apiserver:v1.28.15</span></span></p>
<p id="ue0691d87" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.aliyuncs.com/google_containers/kube-controller-manager:v1.28.15</span></p>
<p id="ud02d8a29" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.aliyuncs.com/google_containers/kube-scheduler:v1.28.15</span></p>
<p id="u9261916c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.aliyuncs.com/google_containers/kube-proxy:v1.28.15</span></p>
<p id="u8c7bdc3e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.aliyuncs.com/google_containers/pause:3.9</span></p>
<p id="uc71e04df" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.aliyuncs.com/google_containers/etcd:3.5.15-0</span></p>
<p id="ua9407be2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">registry.aliyuncs.com/google_containers/coredns/coredns:v1.10.1</span></p>
<p id="u722a79ad" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u4b855da1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">拉取以上镜像推送到自己的harbor仓库：</span></p>
<p id="u3a1237ae" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">去harbor创建google_containers 项目</span></p>
<p id="ue3f4f727" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/google_containers/xxxx</span></p>
<p id="u00cc6a30" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">登录harbor:&nbsp; &nbsp; docker login k8s-harbor.taoyao.com</span></p>
<p id="u25074164" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">执行以下脚本: 拉取镜像，打标签，推送到私有仓库，以免后面集群节点创建时因为网络问题无法获取到镜像</span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">注意镜像版本得和kubeadm config images list 里面显示的一致</span></p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>images=(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">kube-apiserver:v1.28.15</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">kube-controller-manager:v1.28.15</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">kube-scheduler:v1.28.15</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">kube-proxy:v1.28.15</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pause:3.9</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">etcd:3.5.15-0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">coredns/coredns:v1.10.1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${images[@]}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    docker pull registry.aliyuncs.com</span>/google_containers/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">$i
    docker tag registry.aliyuncs.com</span>/google_containers/$i k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/google_containers/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">$i
    docker push k8s</span>-harbor.taoyao.com/google_containers/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">$i
    docker rmi registry.aliyuncs.com</span>/google_containers/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">$i
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">done</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="uac677b50" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">阿里云的仓库中没有 <span class="ne-text">registry.aliyuncs.com/google_containers/coredns/coredns:v1.10.1 。。。。。尴尬</span></span></p>
<p id="u027742ef" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">直接去docker的仓库拉了做成自己的：</span></p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>docker pull coredns/coredns:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.10</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
docker tag coredns</span>/coredns:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.10</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/google_containers/coredns:v1.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
docker push k8s</span>-harbor.taoyao.com/google_containers/coredns:v1.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
docker rmi coredns</span>/coredns:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.10</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>镜像准备完毕就可以进行master节点初始化了</p>
<p>101（192.168.255.101） master机器执行初始化</p>
<div class="lake-content"><span class="ne-text">kubeadm init --help&nbsp; 查看命令参数</span></div>
<div class="lake-content">
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u5db66cac" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">--kubernetes-version 指定版本</span></p>
<p id="u264279a9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">--apiserver-advertise-address&nbsp; master节点ip</span></p>
<p id="u537828e8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">--image-repository 镜像仓库 使用我自己harbor仓库上面准备的镜像</span></p>
<p id="u54a22468" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">--pod-network-cidr pod 网段 可以自己设置</span></p>
<p id="u2aedd08b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">--service-cidr service 网段 可以自己设置 default "10.96.0.0/12"</span></p>
<p id="u524a36ac" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">--ignore-preflight-errors 忽略某些错误</span></p>
<p id="u4399a30c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">--cri-socket cri-socket 我们用docker引擎，配置docker对应的&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251023110729953-108504537.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">

<pre>kubeadm init --kubernetes-version=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.28</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span> --apiserver-advertise-address=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255.101</span> --image-repository=k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/google_containers --pod-network-cidr=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">10.244.0.0/16</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --service-cidr=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">10.96.0.0/12</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --ignore-preflight-errors=Swap --cri-socket=unix:<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">var/run/cri-dockerd.sock</span></pre>

<p>&nbsp;考虑到网络问题，我还是直接把<span class="ne-text">&nbsp;<a class="ne-link" href="https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/releases/latest/download/kube-flannel.yml" target="_blank" data-href="https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/releases/latest/download/kube-flannel.yml" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="ne-text">https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/releases/latest/download/kube-flannel.yml</span></a><span class="ne-text"> 到本地，然后把里面的镜像，通过宿主机下载好，做成自己的 私有镜像推到harbor仓库，再执行。如果网络没问题那就直接执行 这个就行了&nbsp;kubectl apply -f https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/releases/latest/download/kube-flannel.yml</span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="ud7140fa6" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">grep image: kube-flannel.yml</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 可以看到这个文件里面有两个镜像，我们把这两个镜像下载下来，做成自己的之后推送到自己的harbor仓库，修改这个文件中的镜像为我们自己的私有镜像：</span></p>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251023113932724-202373819.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">注意版本和自己<code class="ne-code">kube-flannel.yml</code><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;里面的对应</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>docker pull ghcr.io/flannel-io/flannel:v0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">27.4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
docker tag ghcr.io</span>/flannel-io/flannel:v0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">27.4</span> k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/flannel:v0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">27.4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
docker push k8s</span>-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/flannel:v0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">27.4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

docker pull ghcr.io</span>/flannel-io/flannel-cni-plugin:v1.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.0</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">flannel1
docker tag ghcr.io</span>/flannel-io/flannel-cni-plugin:v1.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.0</span>-flannel1 k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/flannel-cni-plugin:v1.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.0</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">flannel1
docker push k8s</span>-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/flannel-cni-plugin:v1.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.0</span>-flannel1</pre>

<p id="u326db699" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">至此k8s集群基本搭建完毕。</span></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u0cec4f2f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">kubectl docker cri-dockered&nbsp; 必须设置为开机自启动，否则重启机器会导致服务有问题。</span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">kubectl docker cri-dockered&nbsp;必须设置为开机自启动，否则重启机器会导致服务有问题。</span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">kubectl docker cri-dockered 必须设置为开机自启动，否则重启机器会导致服务有问题。</span></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kubeadm方式部署集群其实是将各个组件以pod的形式部署在k8s中：</span></p>
<p>kubectl get pods -A&nbsp; &nbsp;查看所有pods</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251023145751742-354163925.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>四、k8s组件介绍</h1>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251023150014823-681945848.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i74.26db2e31S1mO2L">控制平面组件（Control Plane）</h2>
<p>控制平面负责管理整个集群，通常部署在 Master 节点。</p>
<h3 data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i75.26db2e31S1mO2L"><span data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i77.26db2e31S1mO2L">kube-apiserver（API 服务器）</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>功能：集群的“前端”，所有组件都通过它通信</li>
<li data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i76.26db2e31S1mO2L">作用：
<ul>
<li>暴露 REST API（<code>kubectl</code>、UI、其他组件）</li>
<li>认证、授权、准入控制</li>
<li>集群状态的唯一入口</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>特点：无状态，可水平扩展（通过负载均衡）</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i78.26db2e31S1mO2L">etcd（分布式键值存储）</h3>
<ul>
<li>功能：存储集群所有状态数据（Pod、Service、ConfigMap 等）</li>
<li>特点：
<ul>
<li>强一致性（Raft 算法）</li>
<li>高可用（3/5/7 节点集群）</li>
<li>唯一真相来源</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>重要：必须定期备份！</li>
</ul>
<h3><span data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i80.26db2e31S1mO2L">kube-scheduler（调度器）</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>功能：决定 Pod 在哪个节点上运行</li>
<li>调度策略：
<ul>
<li>资源需求（CPU、内存）</li>
<li>亲和性/反亲和性</li>
<li>污点/容忍（Taints/Tolerations）</li>
<li>节点选择器（NodeSelector）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>特点：可插拔调度器框架</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">&nbsp;
<h3 data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i82.26db2e31S1mO2L">&nbsp;kube-controller-manager（控制器管理器）</h3>
<ul>
<li>功能：运行各种控制器，维护集群期望状态</li>
<li>内置控制器：
<ul>
<li>Node Controller：节点故障检测</li>
<li>Replication Controller：Pod 副本管理</li>
<li>Deployment Controller：滚动更新</li>
<li>DaemonSet Controller：守护进程集</li>
<li>StatefulSet Controller：有状态应用</li>
<li>Service Controller：负载均衡、路由</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>特点：可水平扩展，高可用</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">&nbsp;
<h2 data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i83.26db2e31S1mO2L">节点组件（Node Components）</h2>
<p>节点组件运行在每个 Worker 节点上，管理 Pod。</p>
<h3 data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i86.26db2e31S1mO2L">&nbsp;kubelet</h3>
<ul>
<li>功能：节点上的“代理”，管理 Pod 和容器</li>
<li>职责：
<ul>
<li>从 apiserver 获取 Pod 配置</li>
<li>启动/停止/监控容器</li>
<li>向 apiserver 上报节点状态</li>
<li>执行健康检查（Liveness/Readiness）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i98.26db2e31S1mO2L">特点：每个节点必须运行一个</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i87.26db2e31S1mO2L">&nbsp;kube-proxy（服务代理）</h3>
<ul>
<li>功能：实现 Service 的网络代理和负载均衡</li>
<li>工作模式：
<ul>
<li>iptables：通过 iptables 规则转发</li>
<li>ipvs：性能更好，基于 LVS</li>
<li>userspace：旧模式，已废弃</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>作用：实现 Service 的 ClusterIP、NodePort 等</li>
</ul>
<h3>Container Runtime（容器运行时）</h3>
<ul>
<li>功能：实际运行容器的软件</li>
<li>支持的运行时：
<ul>
<li>Docker（通过 cri-docker-shim，已弃用）</li>
<li>containerd（推荐）</li>
<li>CRI-O（Red Hat 开发）</li>
<li>gVisor（安全沙箱）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i89.26db2e31S1mO2L">要求：必须符合 CRI（Container Runtime Interface）</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i90.26db2e31S1mO2L">可选组件（Addons）</h2>
<h3>DNS（CoreDNS）</h3>
<ul>
<li>功能：为 Service 提供域名解析</li>
<li>作用：<code data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i91.26db2e31S1mO2L">my-service.namespace.svc.cluster.local</code></li>
</ul>
<h3><span data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i93.26db2e31S1mO2L">Web UI（Dashboard）</span></h3>
<ul>
<li data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i92.26db2e31S1mO2L">功能：图形化管理界面</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i95.26db2e31S1mO2L">&nbsp;Container Resource Monitoring（Prometheus + Grafana）</h3>
<ul>
<li data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i94.26db2e31S1mO2L">功能：监控容器和节点资源使用</li>
</ul>
<h3><span data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i97.26db2e31S1mO2L">Cluster-level Logging（EFK/Elasticsearch-Fluentd-Kibana）</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>功能：集中日志收集和分析</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 data-spm-anchor-id="5176.29237709.0.i99.26db2e31S1mO2L">组件交互流程（以创建 Pod 为例）</h2>
